scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof provides all-parameter classification and exponent bounds. Small finite computations are corroborating only. Structural work by other authors is credited, no independent review or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified split almost-abelian Lie family and idempotent linear Nijenhuis maps. Fixed-field asymptotics; no extension to arbitrary almost-abelian algebras. General integrable-projection criterion and Gaussian counts are prior tools. Independent publication priority may be affected by broader product-structure counts.
title: Characteristic-two fusion in idempotent Nijenhuis ranks of two-eigenvalue Lie algebras
